beats.text: They say you keep the Palace lamp now. Up the Hundred Steps at dawn, and back down for the round.

beats.text: Nobody asked you anything. They handed it you. Cold iron, that is how it goes.

beats.speaker: lamp
beats.text: Then I'll keep it lit and walk the round after. Fen-sure, the Sump won't walk itself.

quests.title: Where Is the King?
quests.summary: The Sump patrolman who was handed the Palace lamp is still walking his round. His patrol partner wants him found before the Houses find him.

offer.say: #greet#. You've a nose on you, I can tell. My patrol partner's been handed the Palace lamp and he's still walking our round. Find him before the Houses do.
offer.handIn: I found him. On his round, like you said.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. He asked after you. Don't let it go to your head.
offer.during: Ask the porters on the Sump Stairs. They see every wolf go down. Then follow your nose. He's not hard to smell.

objectives.label: Ask a porter on the Sump Stairs who has gone down.
Find the stair down to the Sunken Street, off the Commons.
Find him on his round at dusk.
Talk with him.
Walk the round with him: the first post.
The second post.
And the third.

bonus.detail: walked the Sump round with the new King

quests.title: The Summons
quests.summary: The Palace sends its word to every hearth, and the Palace has no wolves to send. Carry the herald's Summons to a town's Keeper.

offer.ask: Is there word from the Palace?
offer.say: #greet#. The Palace sends its word to every hearth, and the Palace has no wolves to send. Carry a Summons to a town's Keeper?
offer.accept: Give me one. I'll carry it.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Every hearth that hears it is one more voice.
offer.duringAsk: Who takes the Summons in each town?
offer.during: The wolf who'd howl for it. The loom master in Coldwater, the linen master in Larkfield, the shopkeepers in Fenshore and Saltwell. Ask at the square.

objectives.label: Give a Summons to a town's Keeper (each town you carry it to counts).

rewards.text: #thanks#. Every hearth that hears it is one more voice. Carry the rest as far as they will go.

quests.title: Willa's Wheel-Rut
quests.summary: The Coldwater carter took her wagon out on the Oakhaven road and it hasn't come home. She knows that road blind.

offer.say: #greet#, #address#. Willa took the wagon out on the Oakhaven road on Hearthday and it hasn't floated home. She knows that road blind. Would you look?
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Net and line, I thought we'd lost her.
offer.during: Below Alder Mere the road bends under the oaks. Smell for wet ash, eh? That's not ours.

objectives.label: Find her wagon wheel on the road below Alder Mere.
Follow the wet-ash smell to the camp by the mere.
Get her out of the camp.
Walk her home to the Coldwater square.
Carry her Summons on to Oakhaven's Keeper.

rewards.detail: walked the Coldwater carter home from Alder Mere

quests.title: The Wronged Logger
quests.summary: Half of Oakhaven calls the logger a thief over a robbed wagon's wool. The wool went somewhere. Find where, and put the gossip right.

objectives.label: Talk to the logger herself.
Find the stolen wool at the camp by Alder Mere. It smells of the camp's smoke, not cedar sap.
Carry the wool back to the Oakhaven storekeeper.
Put three of the gossips right.

quests.title: The Queen's Purse
quests.summary: The Houses offer to pay for the old King's wake. The Queen would rather pay in her own coin, if anyone can find it.

offer.ask: Is something troubling you, my lady?
offer.say: #greet#. A King's wake, and the Houses offering to pay for it. I'd rather pay in my own coin. Help me find it.
offer.handIn: I found the household's old tolls, and the kitchen's fed.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Now, how shall we pay for the wake? Tell me straight.
offer.duringAsk: Where would the old tolls be?
offer.during: In the Records Office, three rolls deep, under the Houses' own. Nobody reads below the Houses.

objectives.label: Search the Records Office for the household's old tolls.
Have the clerk read the household rolls out.
Give two loaves at the Soup Kitchen for the wake. It is full of an evening.
And two bunches of herbs, at the Soup Kitchen.

rewards.detail: found the old household tolls for the Queen

tests.name: Five wolves play it all: King, Summons, camp, four side stories; the bar met, the Blaze
One active wolf: the small fight frees the carter; the bar short, the Council reads first
Advance anyway on day one: nobody came, the chalk on the new moon, the scene fails
Two hundred active wolves: 59 who carried a Summons is not 30%, the sixtieth is
Five active wolves: two under the floor of three, the third moves it; no scene heard
Soft maximum: auto off waits, the bar holds it, auto on and the bar let go moves it
